interpretation.plain_speak: The scheduler now obeys a simple resource law. What matters is not throughput by itself; it is how many of the six corrective actions can actually be deployed before the window closes. Each unreachable action costs four aggregate failures in both tested deadline profiles.
interpretation.north_star_question: This gives Wingless a compact resource-pressure quantity that can be computed before acting: reachable corrective budget under remaining time and throughput.
interpretation.next_stage: replicate the reachability law across different total budgets before treating it as a general resource-pressure primitive
